title: Dental PPO Plans Waiting Periods, Prior Coverage Credit and Missing-Tooth Clause Schedule
content:
Waiting periods under the Dental PPO Plans are stated in calendar months. The following values apply per plan.

| | Preventive 750 | Value 1000 | Classic 1250 | Plus 1500 | Premier 2000 | Elite 2500 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Basic waiting period, individual and individual exchange enrollments (months) | 0 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 3 | 0 |
| Major waiting period, individual and individual exchange enrollments (months) | 0 | 0 | 12 | 12 | 9 | 6 |
| Basic waiting period, group late entrants (months) | 0 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 | 6 |
| Major waiting period, group late entrants (months) | 0 | 0 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Prior coverage credit method | None | Month for month | Month for month | Month for month | Month for month | Month for month |
| Maximum gap for prior coverage credit (calendar days) | 63 | 63 | 63 | 63 | 63 | 63 |
| Upgrade waiting period applies | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Missing-tooth clause (months) | 0 | 0 | 24 | 12 | 12 | 0 |

**Waiting periods.** The individual figures are the calendar months from the coverage effective date before basic-class or major-class services are payable for individual and individual exchange enrollments; 0 means none, or that the class is not covered. The late-entrant figures are the calendar months from the coverage effective date before basic-class or major-class services are payable for group late entrants; group enrollees entering at open enrollment, as new hires or by special enrollment have none.

**Prior coverage credit method.** "None" means documented prior coverage gives no credit. "Month for month" means each documented month of prior coverage shortens every waiting period by one month.

**Maximum gap.** Prior coverage earns waiting-period credit only if it ended no more than 63 calendar days before the coverage effective date.

**Upgrade waiting period.** "Yes" means that after an upgrade, benefits that are new or richer under the new plan carry the new plan's waiting periods counted from the plan change date, while benefits already payable under the prior plan stay payable at the prior plan's level until then.

**Missing-tooth clause.** A bridge, denture or implant replacing a tooth extracted before the coverage effective date is not payable until the enrollment has been continuously active for the stated number of months; 0 means the plan has no missing-tooth clause.

### Boundary reading of the gap figure (hypothetical dates)
- Prior coverage ending 63 days before the coverage effective date: within the gap.
- Prior coverage ending 64 days before it: outside the gap.
